visualCharacteristics.purpose: grid of investment-manager logo tiles; each tile expands to reveal the manager's details

contentPattern.structure: one row per tile: logo image | manager name | details (rich text). Logo and name may share the first cell. A row without a details cell renders as a static tile; the Red option uses that for a row of category pills

reuseGuidance: Use for logo or name tiles that expand in place to show more detail. Only one tile is open at a time. For a plain list of questions and answers use a standard accordion.
